instruction: Add 'DEMO' to the slide and make the slide's background orange.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a note 'DEMO' to the slide and changing background color to orange (RGB: 255, 165, 0). The evaluator checks both the note text (case-sensitive) and the background color. Custom getter extracts both note text and background RGB from the PPTX file, and custom metric compares them with expected values (50% score for note match, 50% for color match).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: note text 'DEMO' (case-sensitive) and orange background color RGB [255, 165, 0]
Getter logic correctly extracts note text from notes_slide.notes_text_frame and background RGB from slide.background.fill (handles both solid fill and inherited from master)
Metric logic appropriately uses exact matching for both note text and RGB color with balanced 50/50 scoring
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before getter reads it, ensuring state persistence
Expected values are semantically correct: 'DEMO' matches instruction, RGB [255, 165, 0] is standard orange
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should explicitly convert RGBColor to tuple/list (e.g., 'tuple(fill.fore_color.rgb)') for robust type compatibility, though python-pptx RGBColor is tuple-based and should work
Consider adding tolerance for RGB comparison (±5 per channel) to handle slight color variations from different rendering engines, though exact match may be intentional for strict verification
